errors.REPO_NOT_FOUND: Git repository not found in this folder.
errors.NOT_A_REPO: This folder is not a Git repository.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_NOT_RUNNING: The AI provider is not running.
errors.AI_EMPTY_RESPONSE: The model answered with an empty response.
errors.AI_NO_BRANCH_CHANGES: This branch has no changes compared to its base branch.
errors.AI_NO_COMMIT_CHANGES: This commit has no textual changes to explain.
errors.AI_NO_WORKING_CHANGES: There are no uncommitted changes to summarize.
appCrash.title: Something went wrong
appCrash.description: The interface hit an unexpected error and had to stop. Your repositories are untouched — reloading brings everything back.
report.title: Report a problem
report.subtitle: Nothing is sent until you read the report below and submit it yourself.
report.description.label: What were you doing?
report.description.placeholder: What you expected to happen, and what happened instead.
report.preview.label: What will be sent
report.preview.hint: Paths, argument values, repository names and anything token-shaped are already removed. Read it through — you can copy it out and edit it before posting.
report.needDescription: Describe what you expected — without it this report can't be told apart from Git refusing something reasonable.
report.reportAnyway: Report it anyway — I think this is a bug
report.alreadyReported: You already reported this failure during this session.
report.verdict.unclear: This might be a bug — or Git refusing something.
report.reason.protectedBranch: The branch is protected, so the app refused the operation on purpose.
report.reason.hookFailed: One of the repository's own hooks stopped the operation. Its output is the error.
report.reason.concurrentWrite: Something else changed the data first and the write was rejected to avoid losing it.
report.reason.alreadyExists: Something with that name already exists.
report.reason.invalidInput: The value given was rejected as invalid.
report.reason.aiProvider: The AI provider did not answer. Check that it is running and reachable.
report.reason.network: A network or remote-server error, outside the app's control.
report.reason.system: The operating system refused the request.
report.reason.repoGone: The repository could not be opened — it may have moved or been deleted.
report.reason.gitRefusal: Git reported the error itself. It is often a refusal you can act on (uncommitted changes, a missing ref) rather than a defect.
report.reason.io: A file could not be read or written. It may be a permission or disk problem rather than a defect.
report.reason.refGone: The branch, commit or item was not found. It may have been deleted since the view was loaded.
report.reason.unexpected: The app hit a state it does not handle.
report.reason.unclassified: This error is not one the app recognises, which is worth knowing about.
report.reason.crash: The interface crashed. That is always worth reporting.
report.notConnected.title: No GitHub account connected
report.notConnected.body: The app posts issues as you, with your own account — it has no server of its own to post through. Copy the report above and open the issue yourself.
report.duplicate.title: Already reported — issue #{{number}}
report.duplicate.body: Adding your occurrence to it helps more than a second issue: it shows the bug is not specific to one machine.
report.success.commented: Your occurrence was added to the issue. Thank you.
